_comment: Hollowmark buildings and the Wardlamp. levels: one entry per level, in order: cost (gilt, supplies, ink), days to build, staff slots at that level; the late levels (issue #189) also have region (that region of the map must be open: the chapter that opens it unlocks the level) and upkeep (paid every dawn while the building stands at that level; if a resource runs out, the building works as level 3 until the next dawn that pays). start_level: built on a new game (0 = not built). stat: which recruit stat drives the staff effect. site: the @mark in maps/hollowmark.txt where it stands in town. look: sprite kind in scripts/building_site.gd. Effects are computed in scripts/empire.gd (building_effect) so the text always matches the numbers.

buildings.name: Command Table
buildings.blurb: The map of the Inklands and every order you give. Upgrades give earlier warning of Blank surges; a quartermaster cuts the town's upkeep.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.blurb: Bunks, a sparring yard and someone shouting. Your party leaves on missions tougher.

buildings.name: Infirmary
buildings.blurb: Clean sheets, mostly. Injured recruits heal faster, more so with learned healers on staff.

buildings.name: Inkworks
buildings.blurb: Boils soot, gall and worse into Ink. Needs at least one worker. Every Ink province you hold feeds it more.

buildings.name: Scriptorium
buildings.blurb: Quiet desks for people who read the margins. Researchers gather Insight to spend on research{tag:research}, and their Lore speeds up study.

buildings.name: Guildhall
buildings.blurb: Where jobs get posted and coin changes hands. A charming broker brings in contract Gilt. Squads go out on expeditions from here{tag:expeditions}: one at a time per level.

buildings.name: Forge
buildings.blurb: An anvil, a bellows and a smith who has stopped asking questions. Upgrades weapons and makes armour, trinkets and field supplies from mission materials. Needs at least one smith; their Craft speeds every job.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.blurb: Stalls, awnings and a great deal of shouting. Traders bring in Gilt every day and a stock that changes every few days; their Charm haggles the prices down. Needs at least one trader.

wardlamp.name: Wardlamp
wardlamp.blurb: A tall lamp burning Ink. The Blank does not like to be looked at. Built in a province you hold; slows its Fray.
wardlamp._comment: levels: cost, days, fray a day. research: a node that must be known first. upkeep: paid every dawn (a level 3 beacon burns Ink; without it the lamp works as level 2 that day). region_cost: lamp costs (Gilt and Ink) grow by this share for every chapter past the first, so lamps in later regions cost more (issue #189).
